title: Randomized Controlled Trial of a Self-help Book for Insomnia in Patients With Co-morbid OSA and Insomnia

sections.abstract: Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) is a common sleep disorder treated with continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP). Some OSA patients also suffer from co-morbid insomnia. CPAP treatment may be complicated in patients with co-morbid insomnia. This project evaluates the effects of a self-help book for insomnia in patients being treated with CPAP for OSA.
